content: Based on your previous FCC Ni [110] tilt CSL results, identify near-CSL candidates whose two GB planes can be approximated by low-index planes (max_index ≤ 3). Use a maximum 5° deviation per side and a maximum 5° misorientation change. Remove sign-equivalent and grain-swapped duplicates. Remember, now that our candidates are all of the {100}, {110}, or {111} type on one side, you really just need to check whether there is a "near" match on the other side.
